suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as rare infection complication. Require active/prior tuberculosis and a separately diagnosed tuberculous aortic aneurysm attributable to TB. Exceedingly rare manifestation; evidence is review/case literature and individual microbiologic/anatomic attribution is essential. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Mycobacterium Tuberculosis and Aortic Aneurysm
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
